[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Deploy no longer severs the calling turn: caller-thread deploy notice + cross-process cooldown guard (truesight_autopilot#464)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/464
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1151
  
  Details:
  Fixed the deploy-interrupts-other-threads failure class that froze multiple Telegram turns on 2026-09-15 (the indefinite "🔄 Thinking…" hang, plus the 09:24–09:25 double-restart storm).
  
  SHIPPED
  - truesight_autopilot#464 (merged, deployed, verified live on the autopilot box at commit a523db0c):
    * app/tools/deploy.py — _parse_caller_thread() recovers (chat_id, thread_id) from the {pubkey20}:tg:{chat}:{thread} session key (DApp/web -> none); phase-one stashes them into AUTOPILOT_DEPLOY_NOTIFY_CHAT_ID/_THREAD_ID; _notify_deploy_starting() fires immediately BEFORE the systemctl restart Popen so the calling topic gets an honest bounded message instead of a silent freeze; _record_deploy_epoch()/_deploy_recently_ran() cross-process cooldown (90s default, DEPLOY_NOOP_COOLDOWN_SEC) so a stacked second deploy NO-OPs instead of bouncing the box; caller chat/thread persisted into the deploy marker.
    * app/telegram_adapter.py — new send_deploy_starting_notification() (thread-id with 400 fallback); send_deploy_notification() now targets the ORIGINATING topic rather than a default chat.
    * app/main.py — _check_deploy_marker() routes the ✅ completion into the originating topic.
    * tests/test_deploy_notify_caller.py (11 tests) + cooldown disabled in test_deploy_hash_noop.py.
  
  VERIFICATION
  - Local 4-check suite: compileall / ruff check / ruff format --check clean; pytest -q -> 1148 passed with only the 2 pre-existing main-baseline failures (test_config_own_data_repos, test_email_inbox_watch).
  - Found and fixed a footgun in my own first cut: a missing _MARKER_FILE constant was writing a GENUINE /tmp/.autopilot_deployed marker on the live box (would have posted a bogus "deploy complete" into the wrong chat/thread on the next real restart); the nginx restart-order test was also stamping the real cooldown epoch file. Both real /tmp files deleted; suite made hermetic.
  - Live verification after deploy: box HEAD == origin/main == a523db0c; the 11:06:21 restart confirmed as the LAST pre-fix run (phase one ran old code so the thread was not stashed, and the ✅ fell back to the default governor chat). Cooldown guard exercised IN the deployed process via deploy_autopilot() with a real session key -> status "noop", restart suppressed, service ActiveEnterTimestamp unchanged. Phase-two env-stash -> notice -> marker payload asserted end-to-end against the real session-key format (main.py:257).
  - Deliberately did NOT force an artificial deploy to prove the 🚀 notice: the next genuine deploy anywhere is the natural end-to-end confirmation.
  
  FOLLOW-UP FILED
  - agentic_ai_context#1151 (merged, acb5400d): appended 2026-09-15 evidence to the existing OPEN_FOLLOWUPS entry on git_push_changes being unable to target an existing feature branch — added that base_branch=<own branch> is refused by the default-branch guard, and that a second push fails with raw non-fast-forward; recorded the plain-git / Contents-API workaround that shipped.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
